hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, the hook fully handles the swap by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, using a parameterized bonding curve to verify the invariant and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass native AMM math.
